detail.title: Riser 10 Aluminium Phone Stand for Desk - Silver
detail.overview: The Ant Riser 10 is a compact aluminium phone stand designed to hold a smartphone or small tablet securely on any desk while keeping it charging-friendly, with a cutout that leaves the charging port clear so you can plug in without removing the device. Non-slip silicone pads on the base and cradle keep a phone from sliding or scratching while resting at a comfortable viewing angle for calls, videos or hands-free typing. Its all-metal aluminium build gives it real heft and stability compared to plastic stands, and the universal design fits most iPhone and Android smartphones as well as small tablets without needing any adjustment.
